newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Mitsubishi to work with Norilsk, Interros.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi to work with Norilsk, Interros.

text.p: Japan's Mitsubishi Corp and Russia's Interros have signed a cooperation agreement on metals projects, including supplying Asian markets with Norilsk Nickel output, a top Interros shareholder said on Thursday.

A press release from Uneximbank, which owns nine percent of the Interros financial-industrial group and provides much of its financing, said the two sides would cooperate in supplying metals, steel and mining equipment, in production and processing of energy resources and mining and ecological matters.
"In particular, cooperation in the business of supplying Asia with output from RAO Norilsky Nikel is assumed," it said.

An Uneximbank spokesman declined to say what quantities of Norilsk output might be supplied and to whom, saying only that Mitsubishi and Interros would conclude separate contracts on this and other projects.
He said that the cooperation agreement was signed with Mitsubishi Corp and not with any of its divisions.
Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) also owns a 38 percent stake in Norilsk, acquired through a shares-for-loans tender last year, and Norilsk is part of the Interros group.
Russia's financial-industrial groups ally industrial enterprises and financial institutions.
